configuration.discovery: Configuration is discovered from the process working directory, which is this folder - the same as running `kriya generate` here. A kriya.yaml at the root of the repository that contains this folder (this folder itself when it is in no repository), else the Kriya installation, is read; fields only the operator may set need a durable approval.

interaction.note: A change Kriya proposes is held for your review in this window and applied only if you approve it. Any other step that needs a human decision (a knowledge-gap acknowledgement, a skill choice, a command approval) stops the run instead of being approved for you.

toolchains.note: Visibility under this process's own environment (a fixed PATH; no login shell). Which tools a goal needs is only known while the workflow runs; a missing tool then ends the run with Kriya's own typed failure.
